qualification.details: Director, DPSU Coordination Cell (DCC): Graduate Degree in Engineering/Technology/ Science or equivalent discipline from a recognized University/Institutes. Masters or higher degree in Engineering/ Technology/Science (Desirable). Relevant operational, technical, and managerial experience of at least 10 years in defence production, R&D, or technology management, particularly in the field of High Energy Materials, Ammunition and Explosives or research/publications in defence technology.

salary_details.details: Fixed consolidated remuneration of ₹ 1,30,000/- per month. The remuneration will remain unchanged for the term of the contract. No annual increment/percentage increase during the contract period.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.munitionsindia.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Munitions India Director, DPSU Coordination Cell (DCC) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Director, DPSU Coordination Cell (DCC) position at Munitions India is 12th October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate Degree in Engineering/Technology/ Science or an equivalent discipline. A Master's or higher degree in the same fields is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Director, DPSU Coordination Cell (DCC) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 65 years as of the closing date for receiving applications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contract position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed consolidated remuneration of ₹ 1,30,000/- per month for the contract period.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Director, DPSU Coordination Cell (DCC) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Director, DPSU Coordination Cell (DCC) in Munitions India.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the experience required for the Director, DPSU Coordination Cell (DCC) role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 10 years of relevant operational, technical, and managerial experience in defence production, R&D, or technology management is required.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications, shortlisting of candidates based on merits, and an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form should be sent by post to The Chairman & Managing Director, Munitions India Limited, Corporate Office: Nyati Unitree, 2nd Floor, Yerwada, Pune-411006.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.
